contribution.method:
669 native witnesses in 20 problems: `MANIFEST.json` (SHA-256 of every file) and `records/<problem>_nNN.json`. Each beats the current certified coordinate record (main at e0fc321, 2026-10-25) by more than 1e-12: 0.0248 % to 22.34 %, median 7.53 %. All pass `verify_general.py` (VALID) and `certify_general.py` (CERTIFIED), unmodified from e0fc321, run as the workflow runs them (Python 3.12). Wall gaps >= 1.00e-07, pair gaps >= 1.00e-07 (verify_general.py).

**Method and lineage.** The code, searches and constructions were made with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), with Michael Sinko directing. No record starts from a packing of this repository; `found_by` is the credit alone. 663 are PolyPack constructions from its compute study of 2026-10-23: cuts of a lattice packing (the densest lattice packings of octahedra, icosahedra and dodecahedra, the cubic lattice, SC/BCC/FCC box cuts) or of the FCC arrangement of tetrahedral layers, all pieces in one orientation, position and orientation optimised, lattice scaled by 1 + 2e-7 for clearance; 652 are cuts alone and 11 were searched further. 6 come from searches from random starts. 379 delete pieces from a larger packing and rescale the container to wall clearance 1e-7. Searches: PolyPack's warm search (packages/polyhedra/src/search.ts, commit 54e3ca2; seed 1, 150,000 evaluations) or the compute study's basin hopping. Each record's `method` and `source.lineage` give its steps.

**Sources.** https://github.com/sinkomr/PolyPack (`data/polyhedra/`, `docs/spaces/POLYHEDRA.md`; each record links its file at commit 5e62dd6 in `source`) and https://polypack.fly.dev. PolyPack's own certifier (`python/polyhedra/certify.py`, a port of `certify_general.py`) and all its records are public there. **Permission.** PolyPack is MIT-licensed (`LICENSE`: Copyright (c) 2026 The PolyPack contributors); Michael Sinko, its owner, permits publication of these witnesses here under this repository's MIT license.
